retrieval.rag_summary:
Rockwool Reflective represents
stone wool (mineral wool) insulation blankets or slabs laminated with reflective
aluminium foil facings for thermal, acoustic, and passive fire control.
Manufactured from volcanic basalt rock, the non-combustible stone wool substrate
withstands temperatures exceeding 1000°C, while the reinforced foil facing acts
as a vapour barrier and reflects radiant heat. It is used in industrial pipe
lagging, HVAC duct wrap, and commercial building envelopes requiring combined
fire resistance and condensation control.
